text: Hello, little explorer! Ready for ten new letters? Today we'll learn G, H, I, J, K, L, M, N, O, and P. Look, listen, and say the words with me!
This is the letter G. Capital G and lowercase g. G is for giraffe. Can you say giraffe?
Giraffe! G is for giraffe. Let's say G together!
This is the letter H. Capital H and lowercase h. H is for hat. Can you say hat?
Hat! H is for hat. Let's say H together!
This is the letter I. Capital I and lowercase i. I is for ice cream. Can you say ice cream?
Ice cream! I is for ice cream. Let's say I together!
This is the letter J. Capital J and lowercase j. J is for juice. Can you say juice?
Juice! J is for juice. Let's say J together!
This is the letter K. Capital K and lowercase k. K is for kite. Can you say kite?
Kite! K is for kite. Let's say K together!
This is the letter L. Capital L and lowercase l. L is for lion. Can you say lion?
Lion! L is for lion. Let's say L together!
This is the letter M. Capital M and lowercase m. M is for monkey. Can you say monkey?
Monkey! M is for monkey. Let's say M together!
This is the letter N. Capital N and lowercase n. N is for nest. Can you say nest?
Nest! N is for nest. Let's say N together!
This is the letter O. Capital O and lowercase o. O is for orange. Can you say orange?
Orange! O is for orange. Let's say O together!
This is the letter P. Capital P and lowercase p. P is for penguin. Can you say penguin?
Penguin! P is for penguin. Let's say P together!
Let's practice five letters at a time! G, H, I, J, K. Now you say them!
Wonderful! L, M, N, O, P. Your turn!
Great practicing! Now let's play a little guessing game.
Which letter starts monkey? G, M, or P? Point to your answer and say the letter!
It's M! M is for monkey. Well done for trying!
Which letter starts kite? K, N, or H? Point to your answer and say the letter!
It's K! K is for kite. Keep exploring!
Which letter starts penguin? I, J, or P? Point to your answer and say the letter!
It's P! P is for penguin. Great practicing!
You practiced ten new letters! G, H, I, J, K, L, M, N, O, and P. Give yourself a little clap! Tell a grown-up your favorite word. See you next time, little explorer!
